links.outcome: Potentially harmful safety issues, hallucinations and new medications in AI-generated discharge instructions
links.effect: Potentially harmful safety issues attributable to the AI tool in 18% of 100 summaries, including 6% with hallucinations and 3% with new medications.
links.quote: When tested on 100 discharge summaries from MIMIC-IV, potentially harmful safety issues attributable to the AI tool were found in 18%, including 6% with hallucinations and 3% with new medications.

screen.reason: Evaluates the safety, hallucinations, and accuracy of GPT-3.5 in generating patient-centered discharge instructions from MIMIC-IV data, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
